title: Gym Freak
html:
Gym Freak
Skill Type:  Passive
Trainer:  Fighter
Number of Ranks:  1
Cost to Max:  2227
Increase health per point of endurance, adds 5 points to STR and AGI. Decreases mana per point of intellect, decreases INT and END by 5 points.

Gym Freak is a Passive skill that increases the amount of Health gained for each point of Endurance but decreases the amount of Mana per point of Intellect. The skill is useful to characters with low END that need a significant health boost. Because the skill also decreases both Intellect and Mana gained per point of Intellect, the skill is geared more towards Fighters and Rangers who don't need a lot of mana and Mages who have so much Intellect and Mana that the losses from the skill are insignificant.


This skill currently only has one level, so it can not be upgraded from skill trainers. Below is the description as it appears in the game.


"You have spent more time in the gym than entire sports teams combined! This gives you additional Health per point of Endurance. You've also gained additional Strength from the work outs. In addition, catching medicine balls all day has improved your Agility a bit too! The downside? You have a hard time reading your name, much less writing it. This lowers your Mana per Intellect and your Intellect overall. In addition, your Endurance suffered because you didn't stretch and properly warm-up before each workout."

  • +50% Health per point of Endurance
  • +5 Strength
  • +5 Agility
  • -25% Mana per point of Intellect
  • -10% Ranged Attack Speed
  • -5 Endurance
  • -5 Intellect
